issues.claim: Businesses list entry: Cardsmart & Gift (Old Bridge Cardsmart), 3109 US Highway 9 North
issues.problem: Excluded type still in the list. The store's own page states that Card$mart opened its first corporate store in 1996, expanded to 77 stores across the United States, and then lists nine current locations (Old Bridge, Matawan, Morganville, Clark, Howell, Clinton, Nanuet NY, two on Staten Island). It is a chain franchise store, and the mapper's own note admits this ('REGIONAL CHAIN ... the brand describes growing from its first corporate store').
issues.fix: Remove the entry, or get an explicit owner ruling that greeting-card franchises are in scope before spending time on it.

issues.claim: Businesses list entry: Garden Friends, 3018 Bordentown Avenue, 'Old Bridge (08859 mailing address)'
issues.problem: Wrong town against the exact source cited. The NJ DCF licensed-centre list (11/1/2026) the mapper cites records 'Garden Friends, 3018 Bordentown Avenue, Parlin 08859'. Parlin is in Sayreville Borough, not Old Bridge Township. The mapper removed The Peace Rose Montessori School at 3079 Bordentown Avenue as Sayreville on the same reasoning, so the list is internally inconsistent.
issues.fix: Remove Garden Friends (out of zone), or document a parcel-level municipal boundary finding that contradicts the state list before keeping it.

issues.claim: Businesses list entry: Black Tie Cleaners, 3008 Bordentown Avenue, 'Old Bridge (08859 mailing address)'
issues.problem: The company's own site describes itself as 'Black Tie Cleaners-Old Bridge ... in Parlin' and its page title is 'Home | Black Tie Cleaners-Old Bridge | Parlin'. Directory listings give 3008 Bordentown Ave as Parlin, NJ 08859. The mapper's claim that '3008 Bordentown Avenue geocodes to Old Bridge Township, unlike the high-3000s' is not supported by any source I could open, and the same 3xxx-Bordentown-Avenue reasoning was used to delete other entries as Sayreville.
issues.fix: Move to out-of-zone (Sayreville/Parlin) unless a municipal parcel record shows Old Bridge Township ownership; also this entry is a dry cleaner, whose cleaning side is group C per the mapper's own note.

issues.claim: Coverage gap: music schools / music instruction in zone
issues.problem: The Village East Conservatory of Music (2695 Route 516, Suite 2, Old Bridge 08857, 732-546-0702) is an in-zone independent music school with its own website and is missing, even though the mapper added a bulk-directory-only music entry (Academy of Music In Old Bridge) in its place.
issues.fix: Add The Village East Conservatory of Music from its contact page; it is stronger evidence than the bulk-directory Academy of Music entry.

issues.claim: Coverage gap: driving schools in zone
issues.problem: All Brunswick Driving School lists an office at 1810 Englishtown Road, Suite 205, Old Bridge, NJ 08857 (732-800-0014) on its own contact page and is missing. The list only carries two driving schools, both from the MVC licensed roster.
issues.fix: Add All Brunswick Driving School, and separately confirm it appears on the current MVC licensed list.

issues.claim: Coverage gap: pet grooming in zone
issues.problem: Muddy Paws Grooming (dog and cat grooming inside Route 516 Animal Hospital, 2117 County Road 516, Old Bridge) has its own site and operating staff and is missing, while three other groomers are listed.
issues.fix: Add Muddy Paws Grooming after confirming the street address on its site or a map listing; note it is a tenant inside an animal hospital.

issues.claim: Weak / unverifiable entries carried without qualification in the body of the file
issues.problem: Several entries rest on a single bulk-directory record and could not be confirmed on any opened page: Academy of Music In Old Bridge (3883 Highway 516), Main Street Thrift Store (2577 Highway 516), Magic Years Nursery School (not on the 11/1/2026 licensed list), Artworks360, Poker Industries, Superior Signal Co, American Pioneer Electronics, Arch Electric Supply, Miracle Importing, Concorde Distributors, Global Colorants, Suburban Caps, Nifty Packaging, Jon Lauren Apparel, Midhattan Woodworking, In Style Furniture, Collectors Coins, Bright Signs, Island Music Studios, The Arts & Crafts Studio.
issues.fix: Triage should treat these as unconfirmed leads and either verify by phone/map before outreach or move them to a separate 'unconfirmed' bucket so scoring is not inflated.

issues.claim: Scope ruling needed on child care, preschool, dance and music schools (about 12 entries)
issues.problem: The brief's exclusion list names 'schools'. The file carries Good Shepherd Children's Center, Tots & Blocks (two sites), Mae Field Nursery School, Parents Choice Day Care, Happy Days Preschool, Garden Friends, Matawan Montessori Academy, Magic Years Nursery School, plus dance and music schools. If 'schools' is read to cover preschool/nursery/instructional schools, most of these are excluded types and the exclusion criterion fails on many entries, not one.
issues.fix: Get an explicit owner ruling and record it in the file; if schools are excluded, delete the preschool/nursery entries and keep only licensed child-care/daycare centres (or vice versa).

issues.claim: Religious-organisation boundary: Old Bridge Columbian Club and Good Shepherd Children's Center
issues.problem: Old Bridge Columbian Club is the Knights of Columbus hall ('Home of the Knights of Columbus'), i.e. a Catholic fraternal organisation renting its hall, which sits against the worship/religious exclusion; its promoted events are all 2021 and the site footer says 2024, so current activity is unproven. Good Shepherd Children's Center is a licensed child-care business whose own navigation links to its parent congregation (gs4nj.org).
issues.fix: Make the religious-organisation call knowingly in triage; drop the Columbian Club if the exclusion is read strictly, and keep Good Shepherd only as a licensed child-care business.

issues.claim: Boundary call: Grand Marquis, 1550 Route 9 South (banquet/catering venue)
issues.problem: The venue sells catering and in-house dinners ('Anniversary & Valentines Dinner'), so it brushes the 'food' exclusion. It is a legitimate event venue rather than a restaurant, but the entry should be labelled explicitly the way the Cardsmart and Columbian Club entries are.
issues.fix: Add a boundary note to the entry so triage applies the food exclusion consistently.

issues.claim: Duplicate risk: Designer Cards and Gifts Inc (3111 US Highway 9) vs Cardsmart & Gift (3109 US Highway 9)
issues.problem: Adjacent addresses on the same block, both card/gift shops, and Designer Cards and Gifts rests on a single Yellow Pages record. The mapper flagged this but kept both, so the list may double-count one storefront.
issues.fix: Resolve as duplicate before scoring; if Cardsmart is dropped as a chain, check whether Designer Cards and Gifts is in fact the independent store at that address.

issues.problem: The entry carries no website, but totsandblocks.com is the operator's own site (and totsandblocks.com/parent-corner.php is linked from its licensed-centre listing).
issues.fix: Fill in https://www.totsandblocks.com/ as the website.

issues.claim: Address not confirmed on the business's own site: Old Bridge School of Dance, 419 State Route 34
issues.problem: obdance.com opens and is clearly a dance school, but the page I could open carries no address or phone, so the Route 34 address comes only from the map listing the mapper cites (a URL a verifier cannot re-open).
issues.fix: Confirm 419 Route 34 on a re-openable page before outreach, or mark the address as unconfirmed.
